soil.title: Soil Health
soil.signInRequired: Sign in again to view this land’s soil report.
soil.retryHelp: Check your connection and try again. The land may also be unavailable to your account.
soil.emptyHelp: No saved soil report is available for this land yet. Automatic soil-data fetching is not available yet.
soil.modelledNotice: Estimated from soil maps — not a laboratory soil test.
soil.fetchIntro: Understand your land with a saved soil-map estimate across its boundary.
soil.engineOffline: Soil fetching is temporarily unavailable. Saved reports remain available.
soil.cachedHelp: An eligible saved report is reused.
soil.invalidBoundary: Update this land’s boundary before fetching soil data.
soil.retryLater: Please wait a minute before trying again.
soil.fetchFailed: We could not finish this soil fetch. Your saved report is safe. Please try again.
soil.refreshNeeded: The boundary, source or review period has changed. Fetch an updated estimate.
soil.canLeave: You can leave this page. Processing continues and the result is saved to your land.
soil.stepFetch: Read soil maps across the parcel
soil.partialHelp: Some source data is missing. This partial estimate has not replaced your complete saved soil record.
soil.pixelHelp: Nearby positions can share the same 250 m source pixel. They are not independent soil tests.
soil.sketchHelp: Sampling sequence sketch, not a walking route or boundary map.
soil.nutrientNotice: Total nitrogen is not plant-available nitrogen. Available phosphorus and potassium require a suitable soil test.
soil.sourceNotConfigured: Soil source version is not configured on the server. Contact support.
soil.queueUnavailable: The soil request queue is unavailable. Saved reports remain accessible.
soil.scheduledDispatch: Soil requests are queued for GitHub Actions processing. The next scheduled run may be delayed.
soil.scheduledQueueHelp: Waiting for the next scheduled worker run. GitHub Actions schedules are not guaranteed to start immediately.
